name: TEMP - ENJICAD Page ID Diagnostic
description: Temporary read-only lookup for the ENJICAD Facebook Page ID before webhook testing.

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
  ca.id::text AS channel_account_id,
  b.chatbot_id::text AS chatbot_id,
  ckb.knowledge_base_id::text AS knowledge_base_id,
  coalesce(
    nullif(to_jsonb(ca)->>'page_id', ''),
    nullif(to_jsonb(ca)->>'external_account_id', ''),
    nullif(to_jsonb(ca)->>'account_id', ''),
    nullif(to_jsonb(ca)->'metadata'->>'page_id', ''),
    nullif(to_jsonb(ca)->'config'->>'page_id', ''),
    nullif(ca.secret_ref, '')
  ) AS page_id
FROM channel_accounts ca
JOIN chatbot_channel_bindings b ON b.channel_account_id = ca.id AND b.is_active = true
JOIN chatbot_knowledge_bindings ckb ON ckb.chatbot_id = b.chatbot_id AND ckb.can_search = true
JOIN knowledge_base_products kbp ON kbp.knowledge_base_id = ckb.knowledge_base_id AND kbp.product_id = 1103
WHERE ca.channel_type = 'facebook'
LIMIT 20;
